descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Berlin puts you in the captain's seat over the real Berlin.

THE REAL BERLIN
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Fernsehturm, the Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag's dome, the Berliner Dom, the Siegessaeule, Potsdamer Platz, the Oberbaumbruecke, the East Side Gallery, the Olympiastadion, the Wannsee and Sanssouci. Four airfields: Berlin Brandenburg, Tempelhof, Tegel and Schoenhagen.

A LIVING CITY
The S-Bahn round the Ringbahn, the yellow U1 on its viaduct, the ICE and the airport line on their real tracks, yellow buses and taxis on the roads, boats on the Spree and the lakes. At night Mitte, the Ku'damm and the Fernsehturm light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance.

ENGLISH AND GERMAN
Switch every menu between English and German in Settings.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Rummelsburger See, the Oberbaumbruecke and the Fernsehturm out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the Tempelhof Airlift approach, Tegel's farewell, a Spree run, THROUGH the Olympiastadion, Potsdam and the lakes, a fighter scramble, the Ku'damm after dark and a Berlin tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
